title: The Eve of the Kunlun Decisive Battle
next_chapter_hook: When the first rays of dawn pierced the cloud sea atop Kunlun, the Heavenly Eye that had slumbered for eons finally opened its pupil—and Chen Ji had already taken the first step to break the chess game.

text.content: In the instant when the Heavenly Secrets were initially revealed, Chen Ji glimpsed the full picture of the final decisive battle—in the next chapter, he would face that terrifying existence that dwelt above the Nine Heavens at the Kunlun Peak. At this moment, the gears of fate had already engaged, producing a dull clanking sound. The three-day deadline was but an instant away.

The Kunlun mountain range stretched for ten thousand miles, its main peak like a sword piercing the苍穹. The summit was perpetually shrouded in golden cloud sea. Three days prior, Chen Ji had led the Fated Community to this place and begun meticulous defensive preparations. On the surface, everything appeared calm, but undercurrents surged beneath—spies from the three major sects频繁出没, the demonic alliance's troop movements were诡异难测, and even those ancient formations that had slumbered for eons seemed to stir restlessly.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao stood beside Chen Ji, her pristine white sword cultivator's robe fluttering loudly in the wind. She gazed at the sky watched by the Heavenly Eye, her brow凝聚着一抹挥之不去的忧色: "Chen Ji, are you truly certain about tomorrow's decisive battle?" Her voice was very low: "I always feel... something is not right."

text.content: Chen Ji did not turn around, his gaze still fixed on the depths of the cloud sea. His voice wascalm得近乎cold: "Qingyao, you know? From the moment I拾得that page of残缺Tianji Record in the ruins, I knew this day would inevitably come for me." He gently raised his right hand, fingertips tracing a cryptic trajectory in the void: "Mo Xiansheng said the Heavenly Eye has been gazing upon the Kunlun Peak. It is waiting for us."

Mountain wind suddenly rose, lifting clouds and mist across the sky. At this moment, a black shadow如鬼魅般dashed out from the mist and landed three feet before Chen Ji. The newcomer wore玄黑纱衣, with a faint purple spiritual mark flickering between her brows—Ye Qing, the demonic path Holy Maiden. Her lips carried ameaningful的smile as she held a token glowing with幽光in her hand.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing tossed the token to Chen Ji, smiling meaningfully: "Chen Ji, your move to mobilize the imperial secret lines using your Grand Preceptor title was truly masterful." She glanced around, lowering her voice: "The顶尖高手hidden in the shadows by the three major sects have been全部调往Kunlun by your single dispatch. Tomorrow's decisive battle, these ordinarily lofty elders shall be mere pieces in your Fated Community."

text.content: Chen Ji accepted the token and casually tucked it into his sleeve, showing no sign of triumph. His gaze越过Ye Qing, falling upon the demonic army gathering on the distant mountain path. Black war banners遮天蔽日, murderous aura直冲云霄. This massive army汇聚from the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path and various forces, now stood in disciplined formation like a dormant巨兽, merely awaiting its master's command.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing followed his gaze, her eyes flickering with complex light: "My demonic army三十万枕戈待旦, plus the imperial secret lines you mobilized and the顶尖力量of the three major sects..." She laughed lightly: "Chen Ji, your Fated Community name is indeed deserved." With that, she took out a communication Jade Slip from her sleeve, her expression suddenlyserious: "However, there is something you must know—I just received news that the Fate Writer has appeared."

text.content: Upon hearing this, even Chen Ji's瞳孔都slightly一缩. That mysterious existence capable of altering fate's trajectory actually appeared at such a time? Ye Qing seemed satisfied with his reaction, continuing: "She said she is willing to provide us with关键help in the final decisive battle." Ye Qing's smile was meaningful: "Chen Ji, do you think this is fortune or misfortune?"

choice.prompt: The appearance of the Fate Writer was unexpected—this existence capable of rewriting fate,究竟是敌是友? Chen Ji needed to make a judgment.

choices.description: Regardless of the other's purpose, only by seeing her in person can an accurate judgment be made. This was Chen Ji's consistent style of action—meticulous planning, never blindly trusting, yet never blindly rejecting.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence on the Fate Writer
choices.risk_hint: The Fate Writer's identity is shrouded in mystery, may conceal treacherous intentions

dialogue.content: Seeing Chen Ji's毫不hesitated, Ye Qing's eyes flickered with admiration: "As expected of you. Anyone else would have hesitated for a long time." She stepped aside, yielding the path: "She is waiting for you at the eastern cloud sea shore. I will send people to escort you there."

choices.description: The Fate Writer's appearance was too suspicious, cannot排除it being a trap set by the Heavenly Eye. Chen Ji decided to remain motionless and quietly observe the situation.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's brow slightly furrowed, clearly somewhat surprised by this decision: "Very well. You are always cautious, I will not say more." She paused: "If she truly has sincerity, presumably she will come to you proactively."

text.content: The cloud sea surged with万道golden light. Chen Ji stood at the cliff edge, overlooking the万丈deep abyss beneath his feet. Around him, the core members of the Fated Community had gathered—Su Qingyao stood with her sword on her back, Ye Qing stood within the shadows, and even the always taciturn Mo Xiansheng now hovered in mid-air in spirit remnant form, emitting faint墨色radiance.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice rang like a great bell in everyone's ears: "Everyone, the Eye of Heavenly天道之眼 endures through countless calamities, yet it is not without weakness." His remnant soul flickered with a faint glow. "It feeds on the faith of all beings and weaves a net of karma and reincarnation. To break this situation, we must first sever its foundation—cut its karmic ties with the Three Realms."

Su Qingyao stepped forward, her sword-like brows knit. "Mo Xiansheng speaks truly. But the Eye of Heavenly天道之眼 has dwelt upon the Kunlun peak for ten thousand years; its roots run deep and its claws are sharp—far beyond what we can imagine." Her gaze fell upon Chen Ji, carrying a hint of worry. "Chen Ji, do you truly have confidence?"

text.content: Chen Ji finally turned around, his face still bearing that unruffled expression. His gaze swept across everyone present—Su Qingyao's worry, Ye Qing's playful interest, Mo Xiansheng's depth, and the hopeful gazes of those afar. He suddenly smiled, and within that smile was a mix of resolve and madness.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's voice suddenly rose, echoing across the Kunlun peak: "Everyone, I, Chen Ji, am merely a servant disciple of the Tianqing Sect, a label oftrash following me for over a decade." His gaze was like a blade. "But eventrash can stir up storms—because I do not believe in fate!" He abruptly raised his hand, pointing at the无形 Eye of Heavenly天道之眼 above. "From today onward, I will break before I build, I will never stop!"

As the words fell, the Kunlun peak suddenly stirred with wind and clouds. The golden sea of clouds churned like boiling water, an无形 pressure descending from the heavens as if an invisible eye gazed upon this place. Chen Ji sensed that gaze yet showed no fear, instead going to meet it. The corner of his mouth curved into a cold smile: "Good, come. I have been waiting for you for long."

text.content: Just then, a gentle glow rose from the eastern edge of the cloud sea. Everyone followed the light to see a white-robed figure stepping through the clouds, surrounded by faint strands of fate. The newcomer was an extraordinarily beautiful woman, with a golden vertical eye mark between her brows, her deep eyes seeming to contain the karmic cycles of the entire universe.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's pupils contracted slightly: "She has come." Her voice carried a hint of wariness. "The Fate Writer—the legendary being who can rewrite the threads of destiny. They say her abilities counteract the Eye of Heavenly天道之眼, yet no one has ever witnessed her truly act."

text.content: The Fate Writer landed a zhang before Chen Ji, slightly bowing. Her voice was like orchids in a silent valley, yet carried an indescribabledignified: "Chen Ji公子, I have been awaiting you for some time." Her golden vertical eye flickered with strange radiance. "I know you are wary of me. But I can tell you a secret—the Eye of Heavenly天道之眼 is not invincible. Its weakness lies within your Tianji Record."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul shuddered violently, emanating unprecedented brilliance: "You speak of..." His voice trembled slightly. "The eighth page of the Tianji Record?!" The Fate Writer slightly nodded: "Precisely. The eighth page of the Tianji Record contains the method to reverse karma—that is the key to defeating the Eye of Heavenly天道之眼."

choice.prompt: The Fate Writer brought crucial intelligence—the eighth page of the Tianji Record holds the method to defeat the Eye of Heavenly天道之眼. But this also means a final strategic choice must be made.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing clapped her hands and laughed approvingly: "Excellent! I love your spirit! Three hundred thousand demonic cultivators, at your disposal!" Though Su Qingyao's expression was grave, she also nodded, drawing her sword whose light was like snow.

If something goes wrong, at least..." Chen Ji reached out to press her shoulder, shaking his head: "There will be no 'if something goes wrong.'"

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's face changed drastically, she grabbed Chen Ji's wrist abruptly: 'No! Are you insane?!' Her voice trembled, 'Last time you risked your life, almost losing it. This time...' Chen Ji gently brushed away her hand, his gaze tender yet resolute: 'Qingyao, believe in me. This time, I'll come back alive.'

text.content: Night fell, and the Kunlun Summit was shrouded in a faint golden glow. Chen Ji stood alone at the cliff's edge, gazing at the distant horizon. In his hand, the fragmented Tianji Record emanated a faint, eerie light—the eighth page that the Fate Scribe spoke of remained an enigma. But he already had a plan.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji murmured softly: 'Heavenly Eye, you think you're the chess player, but you don't realize you too are a piece on the board.' A cold smile curved his lips, 'From the moment I picked up this fragment of the Tianji Record, I knew—there are no true victors in this world. Only those who survive have the right to write history.'

text.content: Soft footsteps sounded behind him. Chen Ji didn't turn around, yet he already knew who had come. Su Qingyao walked to his side, draping a cloak over his shoulders, her voice gentle: 'It's late at night, the wind on Kunlun Summit is cold.' Chen Ji finally turned, gazing at her profile illuminated by moonlight, and an indescribable emotion surged in his heart.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao didn't look at him, only gazing at the distant sea of clouds, her voice carrying a hint of emotion: 'Chen Ji, I still remember the first time I saw you. Back then you were still a servant disciple, getting bullied and not daring to fight back.' She smiled faintly, 'Who could have thought, thattrash Chen Ji, would now challenge the heavens.'

Chen Ji gently held her hand, his voice low: 'Qingyao, in tomorrow's decisive battle, I will show everyone—trash can overturn the heavens.' He paused, a rare tenderness flickering in his eyes, 'But regardless of victory or defeat, I want you to know... all these years, being able to meet you, is my Chen Ji's greatest fortune.'

text.content: Moonlight flowed like water, spilling across the Kunlun Summit. The two stood side by side, their silhouettes casting long shadows over the sea of clouds. In this moment, there was notrash disciple, no Inner Disciple Senior Fellow—only two souls about to face their final decisive battle. In the distance, the Destiny Commonwealth camp blazed with lights, three hundred thousand Demonic Path soldiers ready for battle, the顶尖 powers of the Three Great Sects secretly gathering—only waiting for tomorrow's dawn, when this chess game spanning ten thousand years would finally face its moment of breakthrough.
